subject: party clears dungeon section
fact: The party successfully cleared an entire section of the dungeon, defeating giants and over twenty ghouls and ghasts.
source_quote: The battle was over. The party stood victorious amid the corpses of giants and over twenty ghouls and ghasts, having successfully cleared an entire section of the dungeon.

subject: newly cleared dungeon area
fact: The party positioned themselves as formidable agents within the enemy stronghold by claiming new territory for the temple.
source_quote: They had claimed new territory for the temple, positioning themselves as formidable agents within the enemy stronghold.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag invited the party to sit and began an ideological training session after they reported their success.
source_quote: Romag, pleased with their accomplishment, invited them to sit and began an ideological training session.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt.
source_quote: He explained that the Temple of Elemental Evil was founded on the principle that the true nature of the universe is constant chaos between the elements, with earth destined to reduce all things to dirt.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The four elemental temples—earth, fire, water, and air—aligned to unify their ambitions and destroy their enemies.
source_quote: The four elemental temples—earth, fire, water, and air—aligned to unify their ambitions and destroy their enemies, planning to settle their differences only after achieving victory.

subject: Battle of Emory Meadows
fact: The forces of the Temple of Elemental Evil were defeated at the Battle of Emory Meadows by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy.
source_quote: The forces of the temple had united and marched out to conquer, but they were defeated at the Battle of Emory Meadows by the Archbishop of Veluna and the Kingdom of Furyondy.

subject: Circle of Eight locks temple
fact: The Circle of Eight, including Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight, including powerful wizards like Bigby, Tenser, and Mordenkainen, had shown up and locked the temple itself, blocking access to the central driving power that gave them their necessary energy.

subject: the orb
fact: The orb is the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth.
source_quote: He revealed that the key was an orb, the only object capable of forcing the chaotic elements to submit to the stability of earth.

subject: the orb
fact: The orb is the shackle that binds the storm and flood, the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.
source_quote: It was the shackle that binds the storm and flood, the tool to impose the discipline of stone upon the reckless factions of fire and water.

subject: the orb
fact: Whoever held the orb would hold the mandate of the temple and have the power to supersede the bureaucratic authority of the greater temple.
source_quote: Whoever held this orb would hold the mandate of the temple and have the power to supersede the bureaucratic authority of the greater temple.

subject: the orb
fact: The orb is the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple.
source_quote: The orb was also the key to the vault that opened the deep places within the temple.

subject: contents of the vault
fact: Romag stated that the contents of the vault needed to be earned and he did not yet trust the party enough to reveal them.
source_quote: When asked what was in the vault, Romag stated that such information needed to be earned—he did not yet trust them enough to reveal everything.

subject: Romag tasks party with recruiting mercenaries
fact: Romag tasked the party with recruiting people to man the newly captured areas to earn more trust.
source_quote: To earn more trust, Romag tasked them with recruiting people to man the newly captured areas.

subject: Broken Blades
fact: Dick Rentsch reported that the Broken Blades, a group of professional mercenaries, were being recruited in Nulb.
source_quote: Dick Rentsch had sent word of a group of professional mercenaries called the Broken Blades currently being recruited in Nulb.

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple was also trying to recruit the Broken Blades, making it urgent for the party to secure them first.
source_quote: However, the Water Temple was also trying to recruit them, making it urgent for the party to secure the mercenaries first.

subject: Watersteide Hostel
fact: The party arrived discreetly at the Watersteide Hostel in Nulb, a run-down establishment with a sign reading 'Rooms are cheap, lives cheaper.'
source_quote: The party traveled to Nulb, arriving discreetly at the Watersteide Hostel, a run-down establishment with a sign reading 'Rooms are cheap, lives cheaper.'

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch took the party to his back room to discuss business privately.
source_quote: Inside the smoke-filled tavern room, they met with Dick Rentsch, who took them to his back room to discuss business privately.

subject: Dren Halveth
fact: Dren Halveth, a half-orc with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye, was the captain of the Broken Blades.
source_quote: Dren Halveth, a half-orc with broad shoulders, scars, and one ruined white eye.

subject: Broken Blades' weapons stolen
fact: Dren Halveth revealed that a shipment of weapons belonging to his company had been stolen by the Crimson Reapers.
source_quote: Dren demanded to know who sent them, what they wanted in Nulb, and which gods they prayed to. The party explained they had gained territory in the temple for the Earth Temple. Dren revealed that a shipment of weapons belonging to his company had been stolen by the Crimson Reapers, who occupied the room next door.

subject: party negotiates with Crimson Reapers
fact: The party decided to negotiate with the Crimson Reapers rather than steal the chest.
source_quote: The party decided to try negotiating with the Crimson Reapers rather than stealing the chest.

subject: Crimson Reaper
fact: A tattooed and scarred Crimson Reaper opened the door and became angry when Calmer asked about the chest.
source_quote: Calmer was sent to knock on their door while the rest of the party hid nearby. A tattooed and scarred Crimson Reaper opened the door and became angry when Calmer asked about the chest.

subject: Crimson Reapers claim weapons as temple property
fact: The Crimson Reaper stated that the chest was temple property that Dren had stolen.
source_quote: The Reaper explained that the chest was temple property that Dren had stolen.

subject: Crimson Reapers give Dren until midnight to join
fact: The Crimson Reaper told Dren he had until midnight to join the temple or he and his crew would be dead.
source_quote: He stated that Dren had until midnight to join the temple or he and his crew would be dead.

subject: Crimson Reapers
fact: The Crimson Reapers worked for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly.
source_quote: The party realized the Crimson Reapers worked for a deeper organization behind the four elemental temples, not one of the four temples directly.

subject: Dren agrees to join Earth Temple
fact: Dren agreed to join the Earth Temple in exchange for one hundred gold pieces to help set up their new business.
source_quote: Impressed by these arguments, Dren agreed to join the Earth Temple in exchange for one hundred gold pieces to help set up their new business.

subject: Wat
fact: Wat, the barkeep, looked very unhappy about the party's success with Dren Halveth.
source_quote: As the party prepared to leave the hostel with the Broken Blades, Zinnia noticed that Wat, the barkeep, looked very unhappy about the outcome, confirming their suspicion that he worked for the Water Temple.

subject: Wat whispers to Dren
fact: Wat approached Dren and whispered something to him, but Dren shoved him away.
source_quote: As they departed, Wat approached Dren and whispered something to him, but Dren shoved him away.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Dick Rentsch said that until they had secured complete power, everyone had to work together, justifying keeping Wat on his payroll.
source_quote: When Calmer questioned Dick Rentsch about keeping Wat on his payroll despite his apparent loyalty to other factions, Dick responded that until they had secured complete power, everyone had to work together.

subject: party brings Broken Blades to temple
fact: The party successfully brought the Broken Blades back to the temple.
source_quote: The party successfully brought the Broken Blades back to the temple.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was extremely pleased with the party's success in recruiting the Broken Blades.
source_quote: Romag was extremely pleased with their success.

subject: Romag assigns territory to Broken Blades
fact: Romag announced that the new territory would be given to the mercenaries, who would report to the party.
source_quote: He announced that the new territory would be given to the mercenaries, who would report to the party.

subject: Romag claims territory for himself
fact: Romag claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself.
source_quote: though he claimed another portion of the cleared territory for himself.

subject: Romag hosts celebratory drinking party
fact: Romag hosted a celebratory drinking party in the newly cleaned banquet hall, which still carried the stench of cadavers and dead creatures mixed with food.
source_quote: That night, Romag hosted a celebratory drinking party in the newly cleaned banquet hall, which still carried the stench of cadavers and dead creatures mixed with food.

subject: Romag toasts to party members
fact: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power.
source_quote: Romag proposed a toast to Sequoia, Zephyr, Zinnia, and Calmer for their contributions to increasing the Earth Temple's power.

subject: Calmer converts to elder elemental god
fact: Romag specifically highlighted Calmer's conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.
source_quote: specifically highlighting Calmer's conversion from a cleric of St. Cuthbert to a follower of the elder elemental god.

subject: party's espionage mission
fact: The party had successfully positioned themselves deeper within the temple's hierarchy, continuing their dangerous mission of espionage and sabotage from within the enemy stronghold.
source_quote: The party had successfully positioned themselves deeper within the temple's hierarchy, continuing their dangerous mission of espionage and sabotage from within the enemy stronghold.
